name: PipeLLM WebSearch
description: RAG-enhanced web search powered by PipeLLM — returns deep, relevant content extracted from web pages, not just snippets. Uses Google Search + Cohere Embedding + Rerank pipeline.

apiKey.description: Your PipeLLM API Key (starts with 'pipe-'). Get one at https://console.pipellm.com

apiEndpoint.description: PipeLLM API endpoint. Change only if using a self-hosted instance.

tavilyApiKey.description: Optional Tavily API key (starts with 'tvly-'). Enables the tavily_search tool as an alternative search option. Get one at https://app.tavily.com

apiKey.label: PipeLLM API Key
apiKey.helpText: Get your API key at https://console.pipellm.com → API Keys → Create Key

apiEndpoint.label: API Endpoint (optional)
apiEndpoint.helpText: Default: https://api.pipellm.ai — only change for self-hosted deployments

tavilyApiKey.label: Tavily API Key (optional)
tavilyApiKey.helpText: Optional. Enables tavily_search tool. Get your key at https://app.tavily.com (1,000 free credits/month)
